scheme_name: Jiyo Parsi Scheme – Health of the Community
other_conditions: Must be a Parsi/Zoroastrian couple (belong to the notified minority community)
Must have borne a child after the introduction of this component in 2017‑18
Must be a resident of India
Annual family income must be less than ₹15 lakh per annum
benefits_summary: Provides monthly financial assistance of ₹8,000 per child (up to age 18) and ₹10,000 per dependent elderly, plus up to ₹6,000 annually for Avesta‑Pahlvi language course fees.
application_link: Step 1: Eligible beneficiaries who wish to avail benefits under this scheme may visit or contact Parsi Punchayets, Anjumans, or Agiaries. Step 2: Collect the application form and fill in the required details, including Aadhaar number, Aadhaar-linked joint bank account details, and other relevant information. Step 3: The district-level committee will review and recommend the applications under the scheme. Step 4: After receiving recommendations and relevant documents from the district-level committee, the Ministry will initiate the process of reimbursement/payment of grants. Funds will be directly reimbursed through the Aadhaar‑based Payment System (ASPS).
